name: open_diff
description: Open the current session's diffs in an external editor: `git diff` plus the session mutation log in a git repo, the patch file alone otherwise. Returns the patch file path and the editor command used.

editor.description: Preferred editor. 'auto' (default) auto-detects: code → cursor → idea → open. Examples: 'code', 'cursor', 'idea', 'git', 'open', 'auto'.

patch_file.description: Optional custom output path for the combined patch file. When omitted a file under the session assets directory is created.

as_patch.description: When true, open the single combined patch file (default: from config ai.diff.open_patch_file). When false, attempt per-file before/after `code --diff` panes (only for VS Code/Cursor).
